CutScene.Text: All that remained was to cross the Broken Marsh.
3000 years past, before the Sundering, the Marsh had been fertile land. Men had settled there. It was the beginning of a thriving empire, centered around the city of Malbec.
The Sundering had changed all that. Huge tidal waves had swept over the land drowning it and its inhabitants, destroying everything in its path.
Ever since that fateful day, it had been known as the Broken Marsh. Few doubted that unquiet spirits of the dead still walked amongst its reeds and pools.
Now however, an army needed to pass through, lest history repeat itself, and the Broken Marsh be broken once again.
